html:
Setting up or upgrading an office in Dubai is a strategic investment. Whether you are launching a startup in Dubai Silicon Oasis, expanding in Business Bay, or designing a premium workspace in Downtown Dubai, understanding the office furniture cost in Dubai is essential for planning your budget.

Office furniture is not just about aesthetics. It has a direct impact on employee productivity, space utilization, and brand perception. From ergonomic office chairs to modular workstations, pricing varies based on quality, customization, and scale.

This guide breaks down everything you need to know about office furniture pricing in Dubai (2026).

Average Office Furniture Cost in Dubai

Estimated Price Range

  • Office chairs: AED 250 - AED 2,500+
  • Executive chairs: AED 800 - AED 5,000+
  • Office desks: AED 500 - AED 4,000+
  • Workstations: AED 1,200 - AED 6,000+ per unit
  • Storage cabinets: AED 300 - AED 2,500+
Budget Insight
Prices vary based on brand, materials, customization, and overall project scope.

Cost Breakdown by Office Type

Startup Offices (Budget Setup)

  • Basic chairs and shared desks
  • Cost: AED 1,500 - AED 3,500 per employee

Perfect for small teams and co-working setups.

Mid-Size Corporate Offices

  • Ergonomic chairs and modular workstations
  • Cost: AED 3,500 - AED 8,000 per employee

This approach strikes a balance between cost and quality.

Premium Corporate Offices

  • Executive desks and designer furniture
  • Cost: AED 8,000 - AED 20,000+ per employee

High-end business environments often use this setup.

Key Factors That Affect Office Furniture Cost

1. Furniture Type

  • Standard furniture usually comes at a lower cost.
  • Ergonomic and premium furniture sits in the higher price range.

2. Material Quality

  • MDF and laminate are more affordable choices.
  • Solid wood and metal are more premium options.

3. Customization

  • Branding with colors and logo integration
  • Unique layouts
  • Premium finishes

4. Office Size

Bulk orders usually reduce the per-unit cost and improve budget efficiency across larger projects.

5. Installation & Logistics

Final pricing also includes delivery, assembly, and site conditions that influence installation complexity.

Cost Comparison Table

Furniture Type Budget Mid-Range Premium
Chairs AED 250 AED 800 AED 5000+
Desks AED 500 AED 1500 AED 4000+
Workstations AED 1200 AED 3000 AED 6000+
Cabinets AED 300 AED 1000 AED 2500+

How to Reduce Office Furniture Cost

Choose Modular Furniture

Modular furniture stays flexible and cost-efficient as office requirements evolve.

Bulk Procurement

Larger procurement volumes usually reduce overall pricing.

Standard Designs

Standard options help avoid high customization costs.

Optimize Layout

Smart planning maximizes space usage and reduces unnecessary furniture spend.

Practical Strategy
Many Dubai offices control budget best by combining standard workstations with selected premium pieces for executive rooms and client-facing spaces.

Dubai Location-Based Cost Insights

Business Bay / Downtown

These areas often favor premium office setups with stronger emphasis on brand image, executive finishes, and refined visitor-facing environments.

Jebel Ali / Industrial Areas

Projects here commonly focus on cost-effective setups, functional planning, and durable furniture for practical day-to-day use.

Dubai Marina

Modern office layouts are popular, often blending ergonomic workstations with collaborative and lounge-style furniture.

Conclusion

Understanding office furniture cost in Dubai helps businesses make smarter investments. The right balance of quality, comfort, and budget ensures long-term value.

FAQs

What is the average office furniture cost in Dubai?

Office furniture costs in Dubai typically range from AED 1,500 to AED 20,000+ per employee depending on the type of setup.

What is the cheapest office setup?

Basic desks and chairs for startup teams are usually the most affordable office setup.

Can office furniture be customized?

Yes, office furniture can be customized based on layout, finishes, branding, and workspace requirements.

Does bulk ordering reduce cost?

Yes. Bulk ordering usually reduces the cost per unit.
